notes: Biggest change: Kelly Courts (Hermosa Beach) reopened this week. The file and the 09-28 research say closed for renovation. The city's Oct 16 e-newsletter (posted Oct 15) announces the ribbon cutting, the city directory lists pickleball 9 AM-7 PM daily with no closure notice, and the use-policy PDF was republished Oct 13. The walk-on, reservation and residency rules in the new policy are unread (download-only), so only status, hours and court count are safe to apply. src/lib/pickleball-home/courts.json on main still marks Kelly 'confirm' (checked Oct 2) and says the policy limits reservations to resident members; that file is outside this task.

With the weekends, the Manhattan Middle window runs unbroken Sat Nov 21 through Sun Nov 29 and Sat Dec 19 through Sun Jan 3. Already past: Labor Day Sep 7, local holidays Sep 21 and Oct 16. Next after December: MLK Day Jan 18, mid-winter break Feb 15-19, local holiday Mar 15, spring break Apr 5-9, 2027.
